author: Argo13
quote: After years of waiting, endless trailers, and enough hype to make Jesus himself pre-order the game, Rockstar somehow managed to deliver a disappointment wrapped in expensive graphics.Congratulations, Rockstar. You spent over a decade making a game, and somehow my biggest achievement was staying awake while playing **** gameplay feels like it was designed by someone who thinks pressing three buttons repeatedly counts as entertainment. The missions are about as exciting as watching paint dry, except the paint probably has better character development.Sure, the graphics look amazing. You can practically see the pores on a character's nose, which is great because apparently that's where all the development effort went. The world looks alive, but unfortunately, the fun seems to have died somewhere during **** hype was so ridiculously massive that I expected the game to cure cancer, solve world hunger, and personally apologize for global warming. Instead, I got a game that makes me question whether waiting was actually worth **** this point, Rockstar could release a loading screen with a $100 price tag and people would call it revolutionary.Final verdict: 10/10 graphics, 3/10 entertainment, 0/10 justification for the hype. I've seen more excitement in a Windows update.
